name: icon-enforcement
description: Icon rules the build must enforce: an icon on every card, no two identical icons on one slide. Executed by scripts/selftest.py, not read by hand.

cases.name: missing_icon_cards
cases.description: Card without icon field should be rejected.

cases.name: missing_icon_grid
cases.description: Grid card without icon should be rejected.

cases.name: missing_icon_list
cases.description: Full-width list card without an icon should be rejected: the field became required in 1.1, because while it was optional every list slide shipped with the same glyph baked into the reference fragment.

cases.name: duplicate_icon_same_slide
cases.description: Same icon requested by two cards of one slide: the allocator must hand out different files rather than repeat or fail.

cases.name: grey_list_slide
cases.description: A list as the whole slide: one full-width grey card with items and its own icon.
